hero.title: Skills, livelihoods & youth leadership
hero.subtitle: Equipping young women and men with the skills, opportunities and platforms they need to build their futures, participate in their communities and shape a more peaceful South Sudan.

programme.heading: The Programme
programme.intro: Creating pathways for young people to learn, participate and lead
programme.text1: Young people are central to the future of South Sudan. EmpowerKids–South Sudan’s Youth Empowerment programme creates practical opportunities for young women and men to develop skills, explore livelihoods, strengthen leadership abilities and have their voices heard.
programme.text2: The programme combines youth leadership, entrepreneurship, mentorship, public participation and platforms for young people to contribute ideas on peace and development.
programme.text3: Our youth work also connects with EKSS’s education and conservation agriculture programmes, creating wider pathways for learning, livelihoods and participation.

featuredInitiative.title: Youth Peace Essay Competition
featuredInitiative.subtitle: Giving young South Sudanese a national platform
featuredInitiative.description: The Youth Peace Essay Competition gives young writers an opportunity to think critically about peace, development and the future of their communities. Through the competition, young people are encouraged to put their ideas into words and participate in national conversations. Selected essays are published in national newspapers, giving young writers an audience beyond their schools and communities.
